blocks.text: Kim? yoki Kimni? — ega va to'ldiruvchi haqida savol

O'zbek tilida «kim» so'zi kelishik bilan o'zgaradi va savol nima haqida ekanini darhol ko'rsatadi: «**Kim** sizni ko'rdi?» (ega — bosh kelishik) va «Siz **kimni** ko'rdingiz?» (to'ldiruvchi — tushum kelishigi). Ingliz tilida **who** ham, **what** ham shaklini o'zgartirmaydi. Farq boshqa joyda — **so'z tartibida** va **do / did** bor-yo'qligida: **Who saw** you? va **Who did** you **see**?

Bitta gapni olib ko'raylik: **Aziz** saw **Madina**. Aziz — ega (kim ko'rdi?), Madina — to'ldiruvchi (kimni ko'rdi?). Agar ega noma'lum bo'lsa, uning o'rniga who qo'yiladi va qolgan qism o'zgarmaydi: **Who saw** Madina? — «Madinani **kim** ko'rdi?» Agar to'ldiruvchi noma'lum bo'lsa, odatiy savol tuziladi (→ 44-dars): **Who did** Aziz **see**? — «Aziz **kimni** ko'rdi?»
Ega haqida savol: Who / What + fe'l

who / what o'zi ega bo'lsa, u shunchaki darak gapdagi eganing o'rnini egallaydi. **do / does / did kerak emas**, so'z tartibi darak gapdagidek qoladi. Nega? Inversiya ega bilan yordamchi fe'lning o'rnini almashtirish uchun kerak edi, bu yerda esa ega savol so'zining o'zi — u allaqachon boshda turibdi. Fe'l o'z shaklini saqlaydi: who — uchinchi shaxs birlik, shuning uchun **Who lives** here? (`-s` bilan), o'tgan zamonda — **What happened**? («What did happen?» emas).

items.text: **Who opened** the window? It's cold in here.

blocks.text: To'ldiruvchi haqida savol: Who / What + do / did + ega + fe'l

who / what to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa (kimni? nimani? kimga?), savol 44-darsdagi oddiy qolip bilan tuziladi: **savol so'zi + yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l**. Present Simple va Past Simple da **do / does / did** shart: **Who did** you **meet**? **What does** she **want**? Boshqa zamonlarda — o'z yordamchi fe'li: **Who are** you **inviting**? **What have** you **done**?

items.text: **Who did** you see at the party?
**What does** Emma want for her birthday?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Who did call you?» → **Who called you?**; «What did happen?» → **What happened?**; «Who live here?» → **Who lives here?** (who — birlik); «Who you saw?» → **Who did you see?** (to'ldiruvchi haqida savolda do / did tushib qolmaydi).

Xuddi shu qoida **which bus**, **how many people**, **whose phone**, **what kind of** kabi birikmalarga ham tegishli. Birikma ega bo'lsa — do yo'q: **Which bus goes** to the centre? **How many people came**? To'ldiruvchi bo'lsa — odatiy savol: **Which bus did** you **take**? **How many people did** you **invite**?

**whom** — who ning rasmiy to'ldiruvchi shakli (Whom did you see?). Kundalik nutqda deyarli ishlatilmaydi — **who** yetarli. Ega haqidagi savolga qisqa javob: Who broke it? — **Aziz did**. Who wants tea? — **I do**. (→ 40-dars).

Eslab qolish: javobni tasavvur qiling. Javob gapning **boshida** (ega o'rnida) tursa — savol ham darak gap kabi, do / did siz: **Who called?** — **Tom** called. Javob fe'ldan **keyin** tursa — do / did kerak: **Who did** you call? — I called **Tom**.
Bog'liq darslar: savolda so'z tartibi — → 44-dars; predlog bilan tugaydigan savollar (Who is she talking to?) — → 46-dars; what va which farqi — → 47-dars.

rows: Who / What + do / did + ega + fe'l
Which / How many + ot + do / did + ega + fe'l

examples.title: **Who** + verb: questions about the subject
examples.description: who ega bo'lsa, u eganing o'rnida turadi va **do / did ishlatilmaydi**: Who **lives** ...? Who **called** ...? who — birlik, shuning uchun Present Simple da fe'l `-s` bilan.

sentences.text: **Who lives** in that big house on the corner?
sentences.translation: Burchakdagi o'sha katta uyda **kim yashaydi**?

sentences.text: Your phone rang at midnight. **Who called** you?
sentences.translation: Telefoningiz yarim tunda jiringladi. Sizga **kim qo'ng'iroq qildi**?

sentences.text: OK, **who wants** another cup of tea?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, yana bir piyola choyni **kim xohlaydi**?

sentences.text: You play chess so well! **Who taught** you?
sentences.translation: Shaxmatni juda yaxshi o'ynaysiz! Sizga **kim o'rgatgan**?

sentences.text: Somebody left the door open. **Who went** out last?
sentences.translation: Kimdir eshikni ochiq qoldiribdi. Oxirgi bo'lib **kim chiqdi**?

sentences.text: **Who has** got the car keys? — Bekzod has.
sentences.translation: Mashina kalitlari **kimda**? — Bekzodda.

sentences.text: Mum, **who's cooking** dinner tonight? — Your father is.
sentences.translation: Oyi, bugun kechki ovqatni **kim pishiryapti**? — Dadang.

sentences.text: In your family, **who gets up** first in the morning?
sentences.translation: Oilangizda ertalab **kim** birinchi **turadi**?

sentences.text: **Who told** Madina about the party? It was a secret!
sentences.translation: Madinaga ziyofat haqida **kim aytdi**? Axir bu sir edi-ku!

sentences.text: Question five is difficult. **Who knows** the answer?
sentences.translation: Beshinchi savol qiyin. Javobni **kim biladi**?

examples.title: **What happened?** — **What** as the subject
examples.description: what ega bo'lsa ham do / did kerak emas: **What happened**? («What did happen?» emas), **What caused** the fire? **What's making** that noise?

sentences.text: **What happened** to your arm? — I fell off my bike.
sentences.translation: Qo'lingizga **nima bo'ldi**? — Velosipeddan yiqilib tushdim.

sentences.text: Look at all this water! **What happened** here?
sentences.translation: Qarang, qancha suv! Bu yerda **nima bo'ldi**?

sentences.text: You're smiling! **What makes** you so happy today?
sentences.translation: Jilmayib turibsiz! Bugun sizni **nima** bunchalik **xursand qilyapti**?

sentences.text: There's a strange noise in the kitchen. **What's making** it?
sentences.translation: Oshxonada g'alati shovqin bor. Uni **nima chiqaryapti**?

sentences.text: The fire at the factory was terrible. **What caused** it?
sentences.translation: Zavoddagi yong'in dahshatli bo'ldi. Unga **nima sabab bo'ldi**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **what goes** in this soup? It's delicious.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu sho'rvaga **nimalar solinadi**? Juda mazali ekan.

sentences.text: **What's** on TV tonight? — A football match, I think.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun televizorda **nima bor**? — Futbol o'yini, shekilli.

sentences.text: Your car is making a funny noise. **What's wrong** with it?
sentences.translation: Mashinangiz g'alati ovoz chiqaryapti. Unga **nima bo'ldi**?

sentences.text: Tell me honestly, **what worries** you most about the new job?
sentences.translation: Rostini ayting, yangi ishda sizni eng ko'p **nima tashvishlantiradi**?

sentences.text: In Uzbekistan, **what happens** at a traditional wedding?
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda an'anaviy to'yda **nimalar bo'ladi**?

examples.title: **Who did you** ...? — questions about the object
examples.description: who to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa (kimni? kimga?), odatiy savol: **Who + do / did / will ... + ega + fe'l**. Who **did** you **see**? Who **are** you going to **invite**?

sentences.text: **Who did** you meet at the conference?
sentences.translation: Konferensiyada **kimni** uchratdingiz?

sentences.text: Your birthday is next week. **Who are** you going to invite?
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningiz kelasi hafta. **Kimni** taklif qilmoqchisiz?

sentences.text: **Who did** Aziz marry? — A girl from his university.
sentences.translation: Aziz **kimga** uylandi? — Universitetdagi bir qizga.

sentences.text: I saw someone famous at the airport. — Really? **Who did** you see?
sentences.translation: Aeroportda bir mashhur odamni ko'rdim. — Rostdanmi? **Kimni** ko'rdingiz?

sentences.text: I'm new here. **Who should** I ask about the timetable?
sentences.translation: Men bu yerda yangiman. Dars jadvali haqida **kimdan** so'rasam bo'ladi?

sentences.text: **Who do** you trust more, your doctor or the internet?
sentences.translation: **Kimga** ko'proq ishonasiz — shifokoringizgami yoki internetgami?

sentences.text: The manager is leaving. **Who will** they choose to replace her?
sentences.translation: Menejer ketyapti. Uning o'rniga **kimni** tanlashadi?

sentences.text: In this photo, **who are** you holding? Is that your nephew?
sentences.translation: Bu suratda **kimni** quchoqlab turibsiz? Jiyaningizmi?

sentences.text: After the robbery, **who did** the police arrest?
sentences.translation: O'g'irlikdan keyin politsiya **kimni** hibsga oldi?

sentences.text: When you need advice, **who do** you usually call first?
sentences.translation: Maslahat kerak bo'lsa, odatda birinchi **kimga** qo'ng'iroq qilasiz?

examples.title: **What did you** ...? — **What** as the object
examples.description: what to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa (nimani? nima?): **What + yordamchi fe'l + ega + fe'l**. What **did** you **buy**? What **does** he **do**? What **have** you **done**?

sentences.text: **What did** you buy at the market?
sentences.translation: Bozordan **nima** oldingiz?

sentences.text: Tell me about your brother. **What does** he do?
sentences.translation: Akangiz haqida gapirib bering. U **nima** ish qiladi?

sentences.text: You're very quiet. **What are** you reading?
sentences.translation: Juda jimsiz. **Nima** o'qiyapsiz?

sentences.text: So, **what did** the teacher say about your essay?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, o'qituvchi inshoingiz haqida **nima** dedi?

sentences.text: We've got chicken and fish. **What would** you like?
sentences.translation: Tovuq va baliq bor. **Nimani** xohlaysiz?

sentences.text: I can't hear you. **What did** you say?
sentences.translation: Sizni eshitmayapman. **Nima** dedingiz?

sentences.text: At the weekend, **what do** you like doing?
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari **nima** qilishni yoqtirasiz?

sentences.text: **What have** you done to your hair? It looks great!
sentences.translation: Sochingizga **nima** qildingiz? Juda chiroyli bo'libdi!

sentences.text: Dilnoza's birthday is tomorrow. **What shall** we give her?
sentences.translation: Ertaga Dilnozaning tug'ilgan kuni. Unga **nima** sovg'a qilamiz?

sentences.text: Tom was cleaning the garage. **What did** he find in the old box?
sentences.translation: Tom garajni tozalayotgan edi. U eski qutidan **nima** topdi?

examples.title: Subject or object? **Who invited** / **Who did** ... **invite**
examples.description: Bir vaziyat — ikki savol. Ega haqida: **Who invited** Dilnoza? — Bekzod. To'ldiruvchi haqida: **Who did** Bekzod **invite**? — Dilnoza. O'zbekchada: «kim?» va «kimni?»

sentences.text: **Who invited** Dilnoza to the party? — Bekzod did.
sentences.translation: Dilnozani ziyofatga **kim** taklif qildi? — Bekzod.

sentences.text: And **who did** Bekzod invite? — Dilnoza and her sister.
sentences.translation: Bekzod esa **kimni** taklif qildi? — Dilnoza va uning singlisini.

sentences.text: **What broke** the window? — A football.
sentences.translation: Derazani **nima** sindirdi? — Futbol to'pi.

sentences.text: **What did** the children break? — The kitchen window.
sentences.translation: Bolalar **nimani** sindirishdi? — Oshxona derazasini.

sentences.text: Somebody phoned Emma. — Oh? **Who phoned** her?
sentences.translation: Kimdir Emmaga qo'ng'iroq qildi. — Shunaqami? Unga **kim** qo'ng'iroq qildi?

sentences.text: Emma phoned somebody. — Oh? **Who did** she phone?
sentences.translation: Emma kimgadir qo'ng'iroq qildi. — Shunaqami? U **kimga** qo'ng'iroq qildi?

sentences.text: In the story, **who helped** the old man? — A young girl.
sentences.translation: Hikoyada cholga **kim** yordam berdi? — Bir yosh qiz.

sentences.text: Then **who did** the old man help? — His neighbours.
sentences.translation: Keyin chol **kimga** yordam berdi? — Qo'shnilariga.

sentences.text: Something frightened the horse. **What frightened** it? — A loud noise.
sentences.translation: Otni nimadir qo'rqitdi. Uni **nima** qo'rqitdi? — Baland shovqin.

sentences.text: The dog saw something in the garden. **What did** it see? — A cat.
sentences.translation: It bog'da nimanidir ko'rdi. U **nimani** ko'rdi? — Mushukni.

examples.title: **Which bus goes** ...? **How many people came**?
examples.description: Which / How many / Whose + ot ega bo'lsa — do / did yo'q: Which bus **goes** ...? To'ldiruvchi bo'lsa — odatiy savol: Which bus **did** you **take**?

sentences.text: **Which bus goes** to the city centre?
sentences.translation: Shahar markaziga **qaysi** avtobus boradi?

sentences.text: **Which bus did** you take this morning?
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab **qaysi** avtobusga o'tirdingiz?

sentences.text: **How many people came** to the meeting?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishga **nechta** odam keldi?

sentences.text: **How many people did** you invite to the wedding?
sentences.translation: To'yga **nechta** odamni taklif qildingiz?

sentences.text: Listen! **Whose phone is** ringing?
sentences.translation: Eshiting! **Kimning** telefoni jiringlayapti?

sentences.text: Nice car! **Whose car did** you borrow?
sentences.translation: Zo'r mashina! **Kimning** mashinasini olib turdingiz?

sentences.text: In your class, **which student speaks** the best English?
sentences.translation: Sinfingizda **qaysi** o'quvchi ingliz tilida eng yaxshi gapiradi?

sentences.text: **Which team won** the match on Saturday? — Ours did, two-one!
sentences.translation: Shanba kungi o'yinda **qaysi** jamoa yutdi? — Bizniki, ikki-bir!

sentences.text: And this year, **how many students passed** the exam?
sentences.translation: Bu yil-chi, imtihondan **nechta** talaba o'tdi?

sentences.text: You've just come back from London. **How much did** you spend there?
sentences.translation: Londondan hozirgina qaytdingiz. U yerda **qancha** pul sarfladingiz?

examples.title: Short answers: **Who** ...? — **Tom did.** / **I do.**
examples.description: Ega haqidagi savolga qisqa javob: ism / olmosh + yordamchi fe'l (→ 40-dars). Who broke it? — **Aziz did**. Who wants tea? — **I do**. Who's coming? — **We are**.

sentences.text: Oh no! Who broke this glass? — **Aziz did**, but it was an accident.
sentences.translation: Voy! Bu stakanni kim sindirdi? — **Aziz**, lekin bilmasdan.

sentences.text: Right, who wants some ice cream? — **I do**!
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, kim muzqaymoq xohlaydi? — **Men**!

sentences.text: Who's coming to the cinema with us tonight? — **We are**!
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun biz bilan kinoga kim boradi? — **Biz**!

sentences.text: I can't find my glasses. Who has seen them? — **Nobody has**.
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagimni topolmayapman. Kim ko'rdi? — **Hech kim**.

sentences.text: This letter is in Russian. Who can read it? — **Madina can**.
sentences.translation: Bu xat ruscha. Uni kim o'qiy oladi? — **Madina**.

sentences.text: Who won the game? — **Bekzod did**. He always wins!
sentences.translation: O'yinda kim yutdi? — **Bekzod**. U doim yutadi!

sentences.text: Hey, who's been eating my chocolate? — Not me! **Tom has**.
sentences.translation: Hoy, shokoladimni kim yeb qo'ydi? — Men emas! **Tom**.

sentences.text: My bike is broken. Who knows how to fix it? — **My cousin does**.
sentences.translation: Velosipedim buzildi. Uni tuzatishni kim biladi? — **Amakivachcham**.

sentences.text: Dinner's finished. Who'll help me with the dishes? — **I will**.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat tugadi. Idishlarni yuvishga kim yordam beradi? — **Men**.

sentences.text: Who didn't do their homework? — **Sarah didn't**, I'm afraid.
sentences.translation: Kim uy vazifasini qilmadi? — Afsuski, **Sara**.

examples.title: Dialogue: who ate the cake?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: kichik «tergov» — ega haqidagi savollar (**Who ate ...? What happened?**) va to'ldiruvchi haqidagi savollar (**What did** Grandma **bring**?) aralash.

sentences.text: — Mum, **who ate** the last piece of cake? I wanted it!
sentences.translation: — Oyi, oxirgi bo'lak tortni **kim yedi**? Men yemoqchi edim!

sentences.text: — I don't know. **Who was** in the kitchen this afternoon?
sentences.translation: — Bilmayman. Tushdan keyin oshxonada **kim bor edi**?

sentences.text: — **Dad was**. And Grandma came for tea.
sentences.translation: — **Dadam bor edi**. Buvim ham choyga kelgandi.

sentences.text: — Hmm. **What did** Grandma bring?
sentences.translation: — Hmm. Buvim **nima** olib keldi?

sentences.text: — Some apples from her garden. She **didn't eat** any cake.
sentences.translation: — Bog'idan olma olib keldi. U tortdan **yemadi**.

sentences.text: — Then **who else came** into the kitchen?
sentences.translation: — Unda oshxonaga yana **kim kirdi**?

sentences.text: — Only the dog. **What happened** to the plate? It's on the floor!
sentences.translation: — Faqat it. Likopchaga **nima bo'ldi**? U polda yotibdi-ku!

sentences.text: — Oh no. **Who left** the cake on the low table?
sentences.translation: — Voy. Tortni past stolga **kim qo'ygan edi**?

sentences.text: — **I did**. So the dog ate it, not Dad!
sentences.translation: — **Men**. Demak, tortni dadam emas, it yegan!

sentences.text: — Poor Dad! **What shall** we tell him? He'll laugh.
sentences.translation: — Bechora dadam! Unga **nima** deymiz? Kulib yuboradi.
